# cubepath_object_storage_tiers (Data Source)

Fetches the available Object Storage tiers with their endpoint, prices and free tier.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `tiers` (Attributes List) Available storage tiers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tiers))

<a id="nestedatt--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tiers`

Read-Only:

- `accepting_new` (Boolean) Whether the tier accepts new buckets.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint.
- `free_egress_gb` (Number) GiB of egress included for free every month, per organization.
- `free_requests` (Number) Requests included for free every month, per organization.
- `free_storage_gb_month` (Number) GiB-month included for free every month, per organization.
- `location_description` (String) Location description.
- `location_name` (String) Location code of the storage cluster.
- `media` (String) Storage media (hdd, ssd).
- `name` (String) Tier name.
- `price_class_a_per_1k` (Number) USD per 1,000 class A requests (writes and listings).
- `price_class_b_per_1k` (Number) USD per 1,000 class B requests (reads).
- `price_egress_gb` (Number) USD per GiB of egress.
- `price_storage_gb_month` (Number) USD per GiB stored per month.
- `region` (String) S3 region.
- `slug` (String) Tier slug, usable as tier in buckets and keys (for example infrequent_access).
- `uuid` (String) Tier UUID.
